name.en-US: On the Groaning of the Dove

description.la: Tres libri de bono lacrymarum et gemituum: de necessitate gemituum, de eorum fructibus, de rationibus gemendi (1617).
description.en-US: Three books on the value of tears and groans in the Christian life (1617). Latin only: the Vivès edition (1870-74) from an OCR scan; no complete public-domain English translation exists.
description.pt-BR: Três livros sobre o valor das lágrimas e dos gemidos na vida cristã (1617).

sources.edition: Roberti Bellarmini Opera omnia, ed. Justin Fèvre, tom. 8 (Paris: Vivès, 1870-74).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.txt, Boston College copy) cleaned by script: running heads, page numbers and the reference-only footnote blocks removed, line-end hyphens joined, recognisable OCR slips corrected by a lexicon pass, so some remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Bellarmine died in 1621; the Vivès edition of 1870-74 is public domain.
